Wild tile. Take all the prisms from one place, optionally with all of one other glaze there. Joins any rack with one glaze; a prism is what goes to the mosaic from a full rack. Counts for rows and columns, never for the full-glaze bonus.
sub: 2 players: 5 in the game (1 of each glaze removed)
3–4 players: 10 in the game (2 of each glaze removed)

t: Round coaster loaded with 4 tiles each round. 2 players use 5, 3 players use 7, 4 players use 9 (twice the players plus one).
Leftover tiles from kilns gather here. You may take all of one glaze from it like from a kiln.
Starts each round in the courtyard. The first player to take from the courtyard takes it onto their breakage line (it fills a penalty space) and starts the next round.
Holds the tiles that are drawn to load the kilns. When empty, the shard box is poured back into it.
Used tiles wait here: the spare tiles of set racks, breakage tiles, and tiles beyond the 7th breakage space.
5 drying racks (1 to 5 spaces), a 5×5 mosaic (printed or unmarked side) and a 7-space breakage line. Everyone uses the same side.
Alone: 1 point. Otherwise: length of its unbroken left-right line (if 2 or more) plus length of its unbroken up-down line (if 2 or more).
sub: Example: joins a line of 4 across and 3 down = 4 + 3 = 7

t: Each round, lose the printed amount for every filled breakage space. A score never drops below 0.

sub: each glaze with all 5 tiles on the mosaic: +10
tie: more complete rows wins; still tied: shared win

t: Grey mosaic: set each tile on any empty space of its row, never repeating a glaze in a row or column. A full rack with no legal space drops all its tiles to breakage.
Adds the wild prism tiles (see Tiles).
